entities.name: figure standing in the hall's west doorway
entities.what: A figure in a long, plain light robe standing in the open doorway in the balcony's back wall, west of the diners, facing out toward the viewer with its arms hanging at its sides; hair or a cap with a squarish top. Sex not clear from the strokes; it may be a serving woman or a waiter.
entities.vis: part: feet at the doorway sill, behind the balcony's inner rail
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄 (setting, if the hall is 十千脚店's)
entities.note: Head u 15818-15832, v 1302-1318 (face frontal, squarish top); robe u 15802-15832, v 1320-1388; the robe ends on the doorway's sill line (v ~1388), which is the balcony floor at the back wall (UPPER FLOOR: floor line at v ~1388 under her, at the back wall; the balcony's front edge at v ~1475). Painted height 86 px. The brief's 'small figure in the window at ~15800'. The restyle paints a standing woman in red with a dark hat here, and adds two small children at the railing below her (u ~15830-15860, v 1350-1400) that the scan does not have: not recorded.

entities.name: head and raised hand beside the doorway figure (faint)
entities.what: A small head with a topknot or cap, turned west, and a raised hand reaching toward the doorway figure, just east of it; nothing of a body is drawn below the shoulders, where a plain panel fills the room's opening up to the lattice window.
entities.vis: part: only the head and one hand; the body hidden behind a plain panel (screen or partition)
entities.note: Head u 15840-15857, v 1293-1320; hand at (15836-15845, 1315-1322) reaching toward the doorway figure's head. A vertical stroke at u ~15837 runs from v 1320 down to the sill (v ~1390) with plain silk east of it to the lattice post at u ~15860. Two readings: (a) a person standing behind a low screen or partition, head and hand over its top, handing something to or beckoning the doorway figure (foot est on the floor line, v ~1388); (b) a figure painted on the screen or wall (then not a person: retire it and give the screen's picture to structures_w). The restyle paints a face here too, but as a half-hidden picture at the top of the opening. Kept as a figure because a miss changes the cast.

entities.name: bearded diner in a dark cap behind the table
entities.what: Bearded man in a dark cap and a light cross-collared robe, seated behind the west end of the dining table, half turned toward the viewer and east, his right hand held out over the table as if talking or reaching for a dish.
entities.vis: part: below the waist hidden by the table and the hunched diner
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄 (setting, if the hall is 十千脚店's)
entities.note: Cap u 16061-16092, v 1318-1328; face to v 1342; robe u 16050-16100, v 1340-1385; hand at (16095, 1365). Foot est between the back wall's floor line (v ~1388) and the table's feet (v ~1420): UPPER FLOOR, floor line at v ~1400 under him. Seated head-to-foot 84 px. The restyle paints him the same (grey jacket, dark cap).

entities.name: diner hunched forward at the front of the balcony
entities.what: Man in a dark cap and a light robe sitting at the front of the balcony west of the table, hunched forward with his forearms resting on the inner rail and his head bowed toward the east; dozing, tipsy or listening.
entities.vis: part: legs and seat hidden by the balcony's inner rail
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄 (setting, if the hall is 十千脚店's)
entities.note: Cap u 16036-16062, v 1356-1366; face to v 1380; back and arms u 16020-16084, v 1375-1420; hands at about (16080, 1395) on the inner rail (v ~1400). No seat is drawn (it is behind the rail): he may sit on the balcony's built-in bench or squat. Foot est just behind the inner rail's foot: UPPER FLOOR, floor line at v ~1432 under him (the balcony's front edge at v ~1475). Seated head-to-foot 76 px. The restyle paints him squatting with folded arms.

entities.name: light-robed figure behind the east end of the table
entities.what: Figure with dark hair (a bun or a small cap) in a light robe at the back of the table's east end, face bent down toward the west, looking at the table and the other diners; perhaps the host or a waiter serving.
entities.vis: part: below the shoulders hidden by the heap on the table
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄 (setting, if the hall is 十千脚店's)
entities.note: Hair top v ~1302, face u 16170-16195, v 1308-1328; shoulders u 16165-16205, v 1325-1345. Head v 1302 is 16 px above the seated diner_cap's: read as standing at the back wall (head-to-foot 90 px, the doorway figure's 86 px), foot est on the back wall's floor line (UPPER FLOOR, v ~1392). Other reading: seated on a bench just inside the room's opening. The restyle paints a woman in red near here (u ~16150-16180) and a big blue-grey man at u 16180-16230; the scan has one light-robed figure.

entities.name: long dining table in the balcony's middle bay
entities.what: A long low table across the balcony's middle bay, set with dishes, with the diners around it: one behind its west end, one at its east end and one hunched west of it; a round basin heaped with fruit or flowers stands in front of its east end (S3.prop.basin_16180).
entities.vis: part: legs behind the inner rail and the diners
entities.note: Top u 16100-16190, v 1377-1392 (seen as a thin plank under the heap); legs at about u 16125-16140 and 16180-16190 reaching v ~1405-1425 behind the inner rail. base = est middle of its feet. Dishes on its west half: S3.prop.dishes_16120. Scale: about 90 px long.

entities.name: heap of round food (or flowers) on the table
entities.what: A big heap of lumpy round things touched with pink and red, piled high in the round basin (S3.prop.basin_16180) that stands in front of the dining table's east end: fruit, buns or flowers.
entities.note: Mass u 16142-16200, v 1340-1378, about 58 x 38 px, with squiggly outlines and pink touches (red is rare on this silk). It could also be (a) the flowered head or patterned back of the diner seen from behind (diner_back_16180, retired at the second pass), or (b) the contents of a basin standing in front of the table (see that figure's note). The restyle paints a dark heap of cloth here. Second pass: the heap sits on the basin's rim (v ~1380), not on the table; its support follows the basin (diner_back_16180 retired). Readings (a) and (b) of the note above are settled as (b).

entities.name: dishes on the west half of the table
entities.what: A few small dark dishes or bowls set out on the west half of the dining table, in front of the bearded diner's outstretched hand.
entities.vis: part: behind the hunched diner's arms
entities.note: Dark small shapes at u 16100-16140, v 1365-1382 on the table top; how many (2-3) is not readable. One prop with the count left open.

entities.name: table (or low couch) in the west bay
entities.what: An unattended table, or a low couch, with a plain rectangular top seen from above and splayed legs, standing in the open bay west of the doorway figure.
entities.vis: part: legs behind the balcony's inner rail
entities.note: Top corners about (15695, 1392), (15716, 1368), (15788, 1368), (15780, 1392); legs and braces at u ~15708 and 15755-15780 down to v ~1425. Scale: top about 85 x 24 px on the silk. The restyle paints a dark-topped table here. Nothing stands on it.

entities.name: pole leaning across the lattice window
entities.what: A straight pole leaning slantwise against the hall's front, across the lattice window east of the doorway, from the sill up to the eave beam.
entities.note: Double-lined, about 5 px thick, from its foot (15930, 1395) on the back wall's floor line to its top (15892, 1292) at the beam under the eave. Two readings: a loose pole leaned against the wall (a prop), or the stay of a hinged window (part of the hall: then structures_w records it and this prop is dropped).

entities.name: bare willow head behind the hall's roof (west)
entities.what: Crown of long, straight, bare shoots fanning up from behind the hall's ridge, like the head of a pollarded willow, on the bank between the hall and the river; trunk unseen. Bare, early spring.
entities.vis: part: only the top of the crown above the hall's ridge (v ~950)
entities.note: Shoots from u ~15880 to 16085, their tips reaching v ~835 at u 16010-16050; they fan from a centre hidden under the ridge at about u 16010. base est on the bank behind the hall: the ground there is hidden by the roof and could be anywhere at v ~960-1250 (between the river's edge, hidden under the ridge, and the hall's back wall); v 1000 assumes the tree stands near the water's edge. One trunk assumed. Species from the long straight unbranched shoots: willow (conf med); the restyle paints a green weeping willow.

entities.name: bare willow head behind the hall's roof (east)
entities.what: A second crown of long bare shoots fanning up from behind the hall's ridge, east of the first and under the big bare tree's lower branches; trunk unseen. Bare, early spring.
entities.vis: part: only the top of the crown above the hall's ridge; mixed with the big tree's drooping branches
entities.note: Shoots u ~16060-16200, tips to v ~845 at u ~16110; their fan centre is hidden under the ridge at about u 16130. Could be the east half of S3.tree.willow_head_16010's fan (two trees preferred: the shoots between u 16046 and 16090 lean toward each other, as where two fans overlap), and its east part mixes with the lower branches of the big bare tree whose trunk goes down behind the hall's east gable at u ~16415 (t2's). base est as for the west head (v 960-1250 possible). The restyle paints a second willow here.

entities.name: small bare bush behind the hall's west ridge
entities.what: A small bare bush or young tree whose short, forked shoots rise just above the west end of the hall's ridge, on the bank between the hall and the river, east of the old leaning willow's trunk; trunk unseen. Unleafed.
entities.vis: part: only the shoots above the ridge (v ~956); the stems go down behind the roof
entities.note: Shoots u ~15620-15790, v 885-956, some forked (V shapes at u 15720-15743, v 897-943), under the long sweep blade of the rafted boat (u 15652-15856, v 844-898). Two readings: a separate bush (the restyle paints one here, its stems meeting behind the ridge at u ~15720), or the lowest shoots of S4b's leaning willow (S4b.tree.willow_15468), whose trunk passes u 15540-15600 at v 850-1000 just west of them; no branch joins them to that trunk on the scan. base est on the bank behind the hall, as for S3.tree.willow_head_16010 (v 960-1250 possible).

entities.name: bare tree at the bottom edge below the hall's west end
entities.what: A medium bare tree whose leaning trunk enters the silk's bottom edge and forks into a broad crown of fine, straight upward twigs spreading in front of the lower roofs and up to the hall's balcony. Unleafed.
entities.vis: part: trunk foot below the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Trunk two strokes, from the silk's edge at u 15717-15740 (v 1773) up-left to (15665, 1610), where it forks. Its west twigs run over the foreground roof's slope edge (u ~15500-15600) and stop at about u 15495. base est where the trunk meets the silk's edge; the true foot is below it. Species: a branching crown, not a willow's whip-head; elm-like or another bare deciduous tree. The restyle leafs it as a willow.

entities.name: forked bare tree at the bottom edge below the doorway
entities.what: A bare tree whose short trunk rises from the silk's bottom edge and splits into two stems in a V, with fine upward twigs spreading east and west below the hall's balcony. Unleafed.
entities.vis: part: trunk foot below the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Single trunk from the silk's edge at u ~15800-15810 up to the fork at (15808, 1710); west stem to about (15780, 1630), east stem to (15850, 1640). base est at the silk's edge. Species as S3.tree.bare_15728 (elm-like). The restyle paints it as a willow with the same V fork at u ~15806.

entities.name: low fan of bare shoots at the bottom edge (west)
entities.what: A low fan of long, straight, bare shoots rising from below the silk's bottom edge in front of the lower building under the hall, their tips under that building's eave: the top of a small tree or shrub (a pollarded willow's switches?) whose trunk is below the silk.
entities.vis: part: only the shoots; trunk below the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Shoots between u ~15900 and 16075 (v 1665-1775), opening upward from a centre at about u 15995; between u 16043 and 16093 they cross the shoots of S3.tree.low_shoots_16145, which lean the other way (an X where two fans overlap). The number of fans is unsure (two read; it could be three, or one hedge-like row); base est at the silk's edge. The restyle paints a row of willow tops here.

entities.name: low fan of bare shoots at the bottom edge (east)
entities.what: A second low fan of long bare shoots rising from below the silk's bottom edge in front of the lower building, east of the first: the top of a small tree or shrub whose trunk is below the silk.
entities.vis: part: only the shoots; trunk below the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Shoots u ~16045-16255, v 1680-1775, fanning from a centre at about u 16145. Its east shoots mix with the west branches of the bare tree whose trunk foot is at about (16345, 1772) (t2's). Count unsure, as for S3.tree.low_shoots_15995.

entities.name: the diners on the riverside hall's balcony
entities.what: Three men eating and drinking at a long table in the middle bay of the riverside hall's railed balcony over the river road: one bearded in a dark cap behind the table, one hunched over the rail and a light-robed one standing at the back (host or waiter); a round basin heaped with fruit or flowers stands in front of the table, and a pot stands on the wall rack behind it.
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄 (setting, if the hall is 十千脚店's)
entities.note: The figures on the balcony at the hall's east end (u ~16340-16400, beyond the east wall at u ~16300) are t2's; they may belong to the same party (the merge decides).

entities.name: the pair at the hall's west doorway
entities.what: A robed figure standing in the doorway at the west end of the balcony, with a second figure, seen only as a head and a raised hand over a screen, reaching toward it.
